description: This file defines the ForBlock class in the SCSSPHP library, representing a 'for' loop block in SCSS compilation. It extends the Block class and includes properties for loop variable, start/end values, and an 'until' flag.

classes.name: ForBlock
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop block in SCSS, extending the Block class, with properties for loop variable, range boundaries, and 'until' condition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ForBlock instance and sets the type to Type::T_FOR.
